segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, so we’re still aiming for a February 10 go-live. I reviewed the kickoff note from your services team, and it lists CSV upload for users. We had landed on SCIM for the 180 seats, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right, SCIM is included for your plan. I’ll get that reflected on the kickoff agenda before Friday’s call.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, good. Our IT lead blocked 30 minutes for that specifically, so I just didn’t want them joining and getting a generic import walkthrough.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally fair. The implementation lead will cover SCIM setup, attribute mapping, and the test group first. That should fit in the 30 minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. One other thing: the invoice that came through this morning shows 200 seats at $34,800. The signed order was 180 seats for $31,320, with the extra 20 as optional in July.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I’m looking at the signed order now. I’ll have billing reissue it at 180 seats and keep the July expansion as optional.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. Our finance team is pretty literal with POs, so if it doesn’t match, they’ll just kick it back.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. I’ll send you the corrected invoice today, and the PO can reference the February 1 start date and the $31,320 annual amount.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. If those two things are cleaned up, we’re good to keep Friday at 11 Eastern.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Works for us. I’ll send the updated agenda and invoice, then we’ll see you Friday at 11.
